scope: Synthetic actual-model post-freeze-holdout; not real-world accuracy
evaluation_scope: independently authored synthetic targeted standards-format conformance checks, not population accuracy
fixture_scope: independently authored synthetic targeted standards-format conformance checks, not population accuracy

scoring_contract.primary_sensitive: Any routed span overlaps supplied sensitive target; report losses of this protection after filtering
scoring_contract.primary_discard: Any span overlaps supplied nonsensitive target, indicating unwanted masking
scoring_contract.secondary: Also report normalized-type overlap and union coverage separately
scoring_contract.pipelines: Actual raw components once, unchanged route, then 8051239 or frozen current filter; no business/glossary additions

candidate_range_character_retention.scope: Candidate ranges may cross nonsensitive context; their character loss alone does not establish personal-data loss

independent_privacy_targets.scope: independent sensitive-target annotation; candidate ranges and personal data ranges are distinct
independent_privacy_targets.annotation_timing: Independent annotation after original raw capture; not pre-frozen detector labels

candidate_range_caveat: Supplied candidate ranges include nonsensitive context. Their character loss is reported separately from independently annotated personal-data loss.
